description: Top posts for an Instagram or TikTok hashtag (up to 10) with likes, comments, views and authors, plus a summary: average and median likes, average views, related hashtags and top creators. Use for trend research, content ideas, finding creators in a niche, or checking how a campaign hashtag is doing. Pass platform (instagram or tiktok) and hashtag (with or without #). Returns summary {posts, avgLikes, avgComments, avgViews, medianLikes, relatedHashtags[] {tag, posts}, topCreators[] {handle, posts, likes, views}, newest, oldest} and posts[] with the same fields as social_stats. Results are cached up to 12 hours by default. Price: $0.04 USDC per call (x402 on Base); not charged if the call fails.

hashtag.description: The hashtag, with or without #, e.g. nepal or #skincare

maxAgeHours.description: Oldest cached result you accept, 1-168 hours (default 12)

name: social_hashtag

id.description: Instagram shortcode or TikTok video id

likes.description: null when the owner hid likes

type.description: post, reel, sidecar, video or slideshow

relatedHashtags.description: Hashtags used alongside this one, most common first

title: Instagram & TikTok hashtag search
